description: This file extends the NodeAppModel class with methods related to resolving canvas host URLs, managing A2UI host URLs, normalizing URLs for trust comparisons, and handling connection state for A2UI interfaces. It contains logic specifically for iOS platform for managing interactions with networked UI components in an OpenClaw-based application.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: Extension of NodeAppModel class with additional methods for URL resolution, UI management, and network checks.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the current canvas host URL, ensuring it is valid and not a loopback address, then appends a specific path.

methods.name: _test_resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Test method for resolving the A2UI host URL.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the A2UI host URL with similar logic to resolveCanvasHostURL, appending a platform-specific path and query.

methods.name: normalizeURLForTrustComparison
methods.description: Normalizes a URL string for trust comparison by lowercasing scheme/host and removing fragments.

methods.name: showA2UIOnConnectIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays the default A2UI canvas upon connection if needed, running on the main actor.

methods.name: ensureA2UIReadyWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Ensures that the A2UI is ready, attempting refresh if necessary, and returning the current readiness state.

methods.name: showLocalCanvasOnDisconnect
methods.description: Displays the default local canvas upon disconnection.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Resolves the A2UI host URL, refreshing node canvas capability if initial resolution fails.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Resolves the canvas host URL, refreshing node canvas capability if initial resolution fails.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Performs a TCP probe to check the reachability of a given URL's host and port within a timeout.
